collection.description: A gardener wonders whether people in distant cities might live far from the soil that feeds them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A gardener wonders whether people in distant cities might live far from the soil that feeds them.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They theorize that food might travel between communities through elaborate trade networks.

text_only.reason: food talked about or imagined; the village's stores do not change

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A farmer worries that storms or broken routes could leave city dwellers hungry.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The children design gardens on roofs and balconies, delighting the gardeners.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The builder questions whether the roofs can hold wet soil; the design returns to the drawing board.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A scholar says some people might devote themselves to other skills and still respect farmers.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A farmer fears that people separated from food production may forget how difficult it is.
